problem: Historical native audits recorded PPT hyperlink/action data through record dumps, while permanent typed native tests did not cover their ID/range bindings, supported source edits or notes/handout metadata publication.
changes: Add six native navigation regressions and three notes/handout master regressions. Existing implementations pass; no production logic changes.

Verify the complete native hyperlink catalog, click/mouse-over records, UTF-16 ranges, stable internal slide IDs, no-op behavior, failure-atomic overlapping-range refusal, targeted creation/replacement/removal, save/reopen and exact-source inverses.
Exercise deterministic durable record-patch replay and inverse without equating append-only inverse publication with original archive identity.
Verify native notes/handout persist owners, exact notes-style package identity, isolated name lifecycle and notes-style XML replacement with independent stored XML comparison.
Clarify notes-style setter error documentation: malformed embedded XML/package content can return a package validation error, while staging grammar refusals use the typed refusal.
Index ppt-365, ppt-366 and ppt-388 as partially asserted; historical fixture-status labels are unchanged.

verification_scope.hyperlinks: The navigation deck retains seed 37 and definitions 12/14/16/18/20 plus 30/31/32/33/37. Old and current definitions intentionally coexist. Exact external URL, mailto subject, internal 260,5,DESTINATION_003 location, relative NEXT/FIRST locations, tooltip and dialog/named-show flags are asserted.
verification_scope.actions: Slide ID 257 shape 4098 owns four click ranges 0..17,18..35,36..51,52..67: external URL, internal slide 260, mailto and NextSlide. Slide ID 261 shape 9218 owns a MouseOver FirstSlide action at 0..16. All sound/OLE/macro/animation/visited/return/unused fields match the native records, and standalone interaction codec round trips retain them. The click resolver deliberately excludes mouse-over events.
verification_scope.text_edits: Changing the external URL/tip allocates definition 38 while retaining all ten original definitions. An overlapping range is refused without leaking an ID or staged record change. Removing the mailto action keeps its unused definition. Sibling actions, all other slide records, original document-stream prefix and unrelated CFB streams survive temporary save/reopen. Retained native inverse restores the exact original archive.
verification_scope.shape_and_hover: A new title-shape internal-slide link and its removal retain all native text actions. Adding/removing a click over the same range as the native hover preserves that hover exactly. Targets are never activated.
verification_scope.durable_and_order: Deterministic JSON replay restores the edited records and hyperlink catalog; its inverse restores original record semantics by append-only publication. Reordering destination ID 260 to the front leaves all slide records and saved hyperlink definitions unchanged, including stale display number 5, but resolves the jump to position 0 by stable ID.
verification_scope.masters: The navigation deck has a NotesContainer master at persist 2 (type 1008, 19,869 payload bytes); the fonts/math deck has a Handout master at persist 2 (type 4041, 10,872 bytes). Both have one main master and no title masters. The notes styles contain one part at /drs/slideMasters/slideMaster1.xml, 1,285 bytes, SHA-256 a8877df932aa27d106ecee8523b841063aa29063cd09536733987fa1a2359889.
verification_scope.master_edits: Notes/handout names can be created, saved/reopened, no-op set and idempotently removed. All unselected master children, main masters, slides and unrelated CFB streams remain exact. Notes-style replacement stores the exact authored body-style XML with sz=1800 in the embedded package. Wrong-owner styles are staging InvalidValue; a wrong XML root is Package(Corrupted). Both failures retain an earlier valid staged change. Inverses restore the original archives.
verification_scope.limitations: No browser/email/file targets are opened, no action is dispatched and no native PowerPoint reopen, rendering, font/layout resolution or master drawing synthesis is claimed. Named-show/macro/program/OLE actions, general title-master creation and broader interaction authoring remain outside these native assertions.
